ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c),
NOT(
OR(
AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c),"Requested"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"Confirmed") ),
AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c),"Requested"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"Cancelled") ),
AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c),"Confirmed"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"In Progress") ),
AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c),"Confirmed"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"Cancelled") ),
AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c),"In Progress"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"Completed") )
)
) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid Status Transition. status can only be in downward order
